FDI in civil aviation sector
*21. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
    KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether he recently met the
Minister of Commerce to discuss broad
contours of allowing foreign direct
investment in civil aviation sector and chart
out a road map for putting in place a civil
aviation policy which would send the right
message to investors;
(b) whether Government are also keen
to bring out greater transparency in the
Rs. 20,000 crores worth aircraft fleet
acquisition plan of Air India and Indian
Airlines; and
(c) if so, to what extent Government
are providing help and assistance to
improve Air India and Indian Airlines?
Recommendations of Naresh Chandra
Committee
    *22. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Naresh Chandra
Committee, set up to formulate a road map
for development of civil aviation in the
country, recommended more FDI, flights
and a regulator, apart from other things;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
Committee recommended to allow the entry
of foreign airlines in the country;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have studied
the Report submitted by the Committee;
and
(e) if so, the decision taken by
Government on the recommendations?
Interest rate on fresh loan to States
*23. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to ease the fiscal stress of States by planning
a 50-100 basis point cut in the interest
charged on fresh loans to States;
(b) if so, whether reduction in interest
rate on plan loans has provided some relief
in easing their debt burden;

(c) if so, what is the total reduction of
interest rate on fresh loans in 2004-05;
(d) to what extent this reduction of
interest rate has provided relief to States;
and
(e) which States have been benefited?
Development of national and
international airports
*24. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of ongoing projects for
development of various airports, both
national and international, in the country;
and
(b) the details of target set for
commissioning the aforesaid airports?
Nationalisation of rural banks
*25. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether rural bank employees have
asked the Central Government to
nationalize rural banks with a view to
effectively increasing rural credit in villages
and to save farmers from the debt trap;
(b) whether rural banks were promoted
with an aim to support small and marginal
farmers and artisans in villages and were
made to extend credit to affluent customers
under the supervision of commercial banks;
(c) if so, whether Government have
considered their suggestions; and
(d) if so, what steps are being taken to
improve rural banking in the country?
Safeguards in foreign exchange
market
*26. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the RBI had
to sell a small chunk of foreign exchange
reserves in June, 2004 to stabilize the
foreign exchange market;
(b) whether it is also a fact that foreign
institutional investors are speculating in the
Indian foreign exchange market;
(c) what safeguards RBI is taking to
ensure that there is reasonable stability in
the value of Indian rupee in foreign
exchange market; and
(d) the details of the guidelines to be
evolved to ensure stability in the foreign
exchange market?
Inter-linking of rivers
*27. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Action
Plan-II of the inter-linking of rivers
recommended imposition of water charges,
levy of cess and duties on some of the goods
of mass consumption, raising agricultural
mandi tax etc.;
(b) if so, the other important details of
Action Plan-II;
(c) whether it is also a fact that according
to the preliminary estimates, an investment
of Rs. 46,000 crores is needed for inter-
linking of 30 rivers and construction of 32
dams in the country; and
(d) if so, in what manner Government
are thinking of mobilising resources for this
mega project?

FDI in international airports
29. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA: Will
the  Minister  of  CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) the policy framed for foreign direct
investment in building two international
airports in Mumbai and New Delhi;
(b) what are the reasons for protests
and dharnas by trade unions in this regard;
and
(c) the measures proposed for a
comprehensive look at all the airports that
need to be upgraded?
Upgradation of airports
30. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL : Will  the
Minister  of  CIVIL AVIATION  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
upgrade those airports which are not upto
the standard of world class airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government in this direction?
Modernisation of IA fleet
31. SHRI  S.M. LALJAN BASHA: Will
the  Minister  of  CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there  is any proposal to
modernise Indian Airlines fleet;
(b) whether it is a fact that Indian
Airlines propose to acquire new planes;
(c) if so, the details in this regard;
(d) whether these planes will be acquired
on Wet Lease system; and
(e) if so, the details of the financing for
the acquisition of new planes?
Privatisation of airports
32. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will  the  Minister  of  CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
privatise airports in the country;
(b) if so, whether Delhi and Mumbai
airports are also being considered for
privatisation;

(d) the details of the airports listed for

(e) whether Delhi and Mumbai airports
are among the profit making airports in the

(f) if so, the details thereof?
Airports in the country
33. SHRI  K. CHANDRAN PILLAI: Will
the  Minister  of  CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of airports in the
country;
(b) the average number of passengers
these airports handle annually, airport-wise;
and
(c) the details of the annual revenue
earned by each of the airports during the
last three years, year-wise?
International airport in Hyderabad
34. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will  the  Minister  of  CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) by when Government are going to
give fast track clearance to international
airport at Hyderabad;
(b) whether it is a fact that the basic
issues have since been addressed in the
recent concession agreement for Bangalore
Airport Project;
(c) whether any specific date has been
fixed by which international airport at
Hyderabad is going to be cleared; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Institutional credit to farmers
35. SHRI RA VULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:  Will  the  Minister  of
FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the farmers
who committed suicide, mostly borrowed
money from money lenders and not from
institutional sources;
(b) the action taken for providing
institutional credit to small farmers by
adopting innovative methods to rescue them
from the clutches of money lenders; and
(c) the measures proposed for a big
push to public investment in rural areas to
assist farmers in getting loan liberally?
Introduction of accounting standards
36. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
 RAO:
 Will  the  Minister  of  FINANCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government Accounting
Standards Advisory Board proposes to
introduce accounting standards for
preparation of financial statements to make
the Central and State Government's
accounts more transparent and user-
friendly; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Foreign aid to States

Minister  of  FINANCE  be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of foreign aid received by
